parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
A block of aluminium has a volume of 3.612 × 10^{-3} m^{3} at a temperature of 0 °C.
Aluminium has a density of 2.700 × 10^{3} kg m^{-3} at 0 °C.
It has a density of 2.620 × 10^{3} kg m^{-3} at 500 °C.
The block is heated so that its temperature increases from 0 °C to 500 °C at an atmospheric
pressure of 1.01 × 10^{5} Pa.
The increase in internal energy of the block is 4.38 MJ.
parts.question_text_latex:
A block of aluminium has a volume of $3.612 \times 10^{-3}\,\mathrm{m}^{3}$ at a temperature of 0 °C.
Aluminium has a density of $2.700 \times 10^{3}\,\mathrm{kg}\,\mathrm{m}^{-3}$ at 0 °C.
It has a density of $2.620 \times 10^{3}\,\mathrm{kg}\,\mathrm{m}^{-3}$ at 500 °C.
The block is heated so that its temperature increases from 0 °C to 500 °C at an atmospheric
pressure of $1.01 \times 10^{5}$ Pa.
The increase in internal energy of the block is 4.38 MJ.

mass = kg
